c._note: Selects a prebuilt ContractCard object (the `c` prop) by mood. Each option mirrors lib/contracts-shape.ts toContractCard() output: mood drives moodFrom/moodTo/moodShadow/statusColor, status label, when, story, cta, ctaHref, pct, paid/left/total (fmtMoney dollar strings from INTEGER CENTS). The full object literal lives in the matching cases/<mood>.json.
